interpretation: The published 0.039 floor compares the exhaustiveness-32 Vina cache against gnina's --score_only re-evaluation of the exhaustiveness-4 poses. Those are two independent stochastic searches, so 0.039 is the run-to-run reproducibility of the whole docking PROTOCOL, not of a scoring function on fixed poses. With placement genuinely held fixed the gap is about half that. Both are real floors and each gates a different comparison; the paper's qualitative readings are unchanged under either, but receptor repair (+0.045) moves from marginal to clearly resolvable under the scoring floor.
